definition: Unwilling or unable to believe that something is true.
book: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
quote: But the incredulous Stuart was not convinced, and when the hand was finished, said eagerly: “You have a strange way, Ralph, of proving that the world has grown smaller.”
example_sentence: She gave an incredulous laugh at the price.
